desc: Derive necessary and sufficient conditions for feasibility for a fixed common sum \(S\), accounting for known and unknown entries in both sequences.
Determine how to search or characterize all possible values of \(S\) without iterating over an impractically large range.
Design an \(O(N^2)\)-acceptable algorithm under \(N \le 2000\), including a correctness proof.
Implement the algorithm in Python with robust input parsing and exact `Yes`/`No` output.
Test the reasoning on cases with no unknowns, all unknowns, duplicate values, and boundary values such as zero.
